description: This PHP class defines a widget for rendering a 'Select' button in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanel layout. It extends functionality to generate the button's HTML and handles access controls, popup configuration, and dynamic properties for use within the CRM interface.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton
classes.description: A widget class for creating a 'Select' button in subpanels, allowing users to select related records via a popup interface. It manages button properties, access control, and popup request data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the widget with configuration properties.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Generates a unique widget ID, optionally including a suffix.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the localized display label for the button.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the button, handling access control, popup configuration, and dynamic attributes.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the localized title for the button tooltip.

methods.name: getAccesskey
methods.description: Retrieves the localized access key for keyboard navigation.
